name: pramagent-guard
description: Deterministic PreToolUse policy checks for coding agents, powered by Pramagent ToolGuard.

interface.shortDescription: Gate coding-agent tool calls through Pramagent policy.
interface.longDescription: Pramagent Guard runs proposed tool calls through deterministic ToolGuard policies before they execute. It is designed for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok-style hook systems that emit PreToolUse-compatible JSON.
defaultPrompt: Show me how Pramagent Guard protects tool calls.
Audit my hook policy before I enable it.
Explain why this tool call was blocked.
